title: Level 0.5 Summary Schema
description: Structured Level 0.5 summary of a single philosophical source: core thesis, argument route, key concepts, interlocutors, and topic tags. Produced by phil-summarize; written to Private/Bibliography/Summaries/ by /phil:ingest.

summary_id.description: Unique identifier with SUM- prefix (see report-id-registry.md)

bib_key.description: The INDEX.md KEY this summary belongs to (AUTHOR-TITLE format)

title.description: Complete title as read from the title page

year.description: 4-digit year read from the PDF, or "nd" if unverifiable

source_type.description: paper = journal article; monograph = single-author book (summarized as one file with chapter segments); collection = edited volume (each member paper gets its own chapter summary); chapter = one member paper of a collection

source_location.description: Canonical PDF path relative to Private/Bibliography/ (e.g. PDF/Austin_1956_A-Plea-for-Excuses.pdf). For a chapter, the shared volume PDF plus page range (e.g. PDF/Chalmers_2009_Metametaphysics.pdf, pp. 347-383)

core_thesis.description: The core claim the text commits itself to, stated charitably

argument_route.description: Ordered sketch of the major argumentative moves (route map, not full reconstruction)

interlocutors.description: Named positions or authors the text substantively engages with

topics.description: English lowercase topic tags aligned with the INDEX Topics column vocabulary

summary_text.description: Rendered Chinese summary, ~300-500 characters, covering all five elements

chapters.description: Monograph only: per-chapter segments within the single volume summary file. Absent for paper/chapter source types.

chapter_no.description: Chapter number or label as printed (e.g. "3", "II")

title.description: Chapter title from the table of contents

members.description: Collection (edited volume) only: manifest of member papers, each registered as its own INDEX row + independent summary file. Absent for paper/monograph/chapter. Distinct from chapters[] (which carries in-file per-chapter summary_text for monographs); members[] is a pointer index, its summaries live in separate files.

title.description: Member paper title from the table of contents

member_key.description: The member paper's own INDEX KEY (AUTHOR-TITLE)

container.description: Chapter (collection member) only: links this member paper's summary back to its edited volume.

pages.description: Page range of this paper within the volume (e.g. "347-383")

philosopher_observations.description: Source-grounded observations used by the private philosopher maintenance queue. Include substantive named figures only; the source author is derived from source_metadata if omitted.

year_verified.description: True only if the year was read from the PDF itself (Rule 2 provenance)
